transcript.text: Which region is the leading region? Answer with the region name.

args.sql:
SELECT c.region, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM memory.bench.orders o
JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY order_count DESC

transcript.text:
West region has the highest order count (339).

FINAL ANSWER: West
